title: Cancel a launch
text: Cancel ends a launch and, when its session has registered but not yet received its instructions, ends that session in the same transaction: terminated, claims released and one native-process reap queued. A delivered launch whose registered session has ended or been terminated settles as cancelled_session_ended. A delivered launch whose session is still live is refused as launch_session_working, naming `yoke sessions terminate SESSION-ID --reason` for a deliberate kill. Cancel settles a failed unregistered launch with recorded native exit evidence, preserving diagnostics. A native whose exit is not recorded moves the launch to outcome_unknown for reconciliation. The steering report hides failures once the assigned item is terminal, a later launch for the same item registered, or the operator settled the launch; unsettled failures have no age cutoff. Native exit evidence renders as native_exited and does not prove the native never ran. A cancelled launch is final; reconcile refuses it. Observed in source and tests; deployed proof is pending.
